name: Verb matches the doer
rule: Find who is doing the action.
One doer: is, was, has, runs.
More than one: are, were, have, run.

wrong.text: The cups on the shelf was all chipped.

right.text: The cups on the shelf were all chipped.

spot: Cover the words in between ('on the shelf') and match the verb to the doer.
deeper: 'Everyone', 'nobody' and 'each' count as one: everyone is here.
Two doers joined by 'and' count as many: Ali and Mei are late.
With 'he', 'she' or 'it', today's verb takes -s: she walks.
